scope: Six existing native Settings persistence cases in guest, authenticated admin, and existing non-admin member modes

auth_contract.guest: Existing default, six UI/storage/reload cases retained
auth_contract.admin: The Prepare runner and D87 use the same actual first-party web-to-extension sign-in helper; D87 additionally matches first-party user UUID to extension storage and requires the admin role
auth_contract.member: D87 and reviewer share first-party whoami identity and canonical admin.admins zero-row proof for the same extension user; D87 requires the existing member fingerprint and an authorized selected organization
auth_contract.private_inputs: The hosted wrapper creates mode-specific mode-0600 files from existing CI secrets and deletes them after the child exits; no credential or magic-link values enter receipts

verification.biome: pass on all owned JavaScript files after final edit
verification.member_proof_test: node --test tests/browser/member-native-auth-proof.test.mjs pass: matching zero-row read accepted, admin row or wrong user refused
verification.product_diff_check: git diff --exit-code 3092444e73094cb0023f6086202869ccbd22978b -- src/features/settings src/lib/settings src/hooks/use-settings pass

runtime_verdict.guest: Prior six-case native pass in .research/settings-final-native.json; not rerun in this source lane

limits: No browser was launched in this source lane; signed-in UI/storage/reload behavior remains unverified until peer approval and an owned native run
The existing member magic link is one-time; the execution owner must supply a fresh authorized link through the existing private CI input without creating an account or sending mail
